label: Cancel construction
summary: A command that cancels the building work in progress at a domicile.
details: Going by its name it cancels the construction under way. Vanilla uses it in the domicile window: a click opens a confirmation popup for the command, and the button is enabled only while the command is valid. It is a command, so it is meant to be run by the game, not read as a value.

label: Custom text
summary: Returns a text made by a named custom localization for the domicile.
details: Going by its name and the same-named function on other types (for example Character.Custom with a quoted name), the argument is the key of a custom localization. Vanilla does not use it on a domicile.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The name of the custom localization to run.

label: Demolish building
summary: A command that demolishes the given building in the domicile.
details: Vanilla uses it in the domicile window with the building of the clicked slot: a click opens a confirmation popup, and the button is enabled only while the command is valid.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The building to demolish.
fields.values: a domicile building, for example DomicileBuilding.Self

label: Above herd limit effects
summary: A text that, going by its name, lists the effects of having more herd than the herd limit.
details: Vanilla shows it as a text in the top bar (hud). The game documents nothing more.

label: Building under construction
summary: The building that is currently being built at the domicile.
details: Vanilla chains it with GetConstructionTooltip to show a tooltip for that building in the outliner and the title window.

label: Construction progress
summary: How far the current construction has come, as a number.
details: Vanilla uses it as a value in the top bar and the map icon layer. In the outliner it is converted to a float and multiplied by 100, which suggests a fraction from 0 to 1 (an inference from that use).

label: Construction status text
summary: A short text that says how the construction at the domicile is going.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the outliner, on the map icon and in the domicile window.

label: Culture
summary: The culture of the domicile.
details: Vanilla chains it to get the culture's name or its collective noun, for example in the header text next to the rite.

label: Faith
summary: The faith of the domicile.
details: Going by its name; vanilla has no use that names Domicile.GetFaith itself. The same function name on other types gives the faith, which suggests the same here.

label: Gold balance
summary: The domicile's gold balance, as a number that can be negative.
details: Vanilla shows it in a balance text, and in the outliner uses one element when it is at least zero and another when it is below zero.

label: Gold tooltip
summary: The tooltip text that explains the domicile's gold balance.
details: Vanilla uses it as the tooltip of the gold entry in the outliner, on the map icon and in the domicile window.

label: Herd
summary: How big the domicile's herd is, as a number.
details: Vanilla shows it next to the herd limit as 'herd: current/limit' and in the top bar.

label: Herd breakdown
summary: The tooltip text that breaks down the herd.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the character window. Going by its name, it lists what adds to and takes from the herd.

label: Herd limit
summary: The herd limit of the domicile, as a number.
details: Vanilla shows it after the current herd in 'herd: current/limit'.

label: Herd monthly change
summary: How much the herd changes each month, as a number.
details: Going by its name only; vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Herd balance
summary: The domicile's herd balance, as a number that can be negative.
details: Vanilla shows it in a balance text, and in the domicile window uses one element when it is at least zero and another when it is below zero.

label: Herd balance tooltip
summary: The tooltip text that explains the domicile's herd balance.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the domicile window.

label: Horde size
summary: The amount of herd that is raised as a horde, as a number.
details: Vanilla texts say that this many men-at-arms of the nomadic riders type will be raised alongside, and that this much of the herd has been raised as a horde.

label: Influence balance
summary: The domicile's influence balance, as a number that can be negative.
details: Vanilla shows it in a balance text, and in the outliner uses one element when it is at least zero and another when it is below zero.

label: Influence tooltip
summary: The tooltip text that explains the domicile's influence balance.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the outliner, on the map icon and in the domicile window.

label: Location
summary: The place on the map where the domicile is.
details: Vanilla chains it to print the barony name, and to pan the map camera to that place when clicked. The game does not name its return type.

label: Main building
summary: The main building of the domicile.
details: Vanilla uses it in a tooltip that explains why a building is locked, chained to the building's name.

label: Main level text
summary: A text that, going by its name, shows the domicile's main level.
details: Vanilla uses it as text in the outliner and the title window. The game documents nothing more.

label: Map pin tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for the domicile's pin on the map, as seen by a given character.
details: Vanilla passes a character: the player in the outliner, Character.Self in the top bar and the map icon layer.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character the tooltip is shown for.

label: Maximum provisions
summary: The maximum provisions of the domicile, as a number.
details: Vanilla uses it in texts written as DOMICILE.GetMaxProvisions, next to the current provisions in 'provisions: current/max'. In the GUI files the text version GetProvisionsMax is used instead.

label: Move cooldown text
summary: A text that describes the cooldown before the domicile can move again.
details: Going by its name only; vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Move-to tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for moving the domicile to a given province.
details: Vanilla shows it as the tooltip of a disabled button in the county view, with the viewed province as the argument.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The province to move to.

label: Move tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for the domicile's move button.
details: Vanilla uses it as the tooltip shown while the move button is disabled, on the map icon and in the domicile window.

label: Name
summary: The name of the domicile.
details: Vanilla prints it in upper case on the map icon and in the domicile window, and in the house view.

label: Name, possessive
summary: The name of the domicile in the possessive form.
details: Going by its name and the same-named function on other types, which are put before a noun in texts (for example a character's name before 'faith'). Vanilla has no use that names Domicile.GetNamePossessive itself.

label: Owner
summary: The character who owns the domicile.
details: Vanilla uses it in trigger texts, for example to show the owner's short name before 'has herd'.

label: Piety balance
summary: The domicile's piety balance, as a number that can be negative.
details: Vanilla shows it in a balance text, and in the outliner uses one element when it is at least zero and another when it is below zero.

label: Piety tooltip
summary: The tooltip text that explains the domicile's piety balance.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the outliner, on the map icon and in the domicile window.

label: Prestige balance
summary: The domicile's prestige balance, as a number that can be negative.
details: Vanilla shows it in a balance text, and in the outliner uses one element when it is at least zero and another when it is below zero.

label: Prestige tooltip
summary: The tooltip text that explains the domicile's prestige balance.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the outliner, on the map icon and in the domicile window.

label: Provisions
summary: How many provisions the domicile has, as a number.
details: Vanilla prints it as text in the top bar.

label: Provisions breakdown
summary: The tooltip text that breaks down the domicile's provisions.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the top bar and in the domicile window.

label: Maximum provisions text
summary: The most provisions the domicile can hold, returned as text.
details: Vanilla prints it in the top bar. GetMaxProvisions gives the same idea as a number.

label: Provisions title
summary: A title text for the domicile's provisions.
details: Going by its name only; vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Rite
summary: The rite of the domicile.
details: Vanilla chains it to print the rite's adjective (for example before the culture's name) or its name in the domicile window.

label: Domicile type
summary: The type of the domicile.
details: Vanilla chains it to print the type's name in titles and move texts, for example 'Move [type]'.

label: Upgrade text
summary: A short text about the domicile's main upgrade, going by its name.
details: Vanilla uses it as text in the outliner, on the map icon and in the title window. The game documents nothing more.

label: Your domicile text
summary: The heading text for a domicile that belongs to the viewing character.
details: Vanilla adds it to the domicile's map pin only when the character is the domicile's owner; for someone else's domicile the pin shows the type's title text for that owner instead.

label: Has building or higher tier
summary: Whether the domicile has the given building or a higher tier of it.
details: Vanilla uses it in the domicile window to show something only when the previewed building tree item is not yet built or surpassed.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The building to look for.
fields.values: a building tree item, as the window supplies it

label: Is above herd limit
summary: Whether the herd is above the herd limit.
details: Vanilla uses it in the top bar to switch between a normal and a warning display.

label: Is constructing
summary: Whether the domicile is building something right now.
details: Vanilla uses it to show or hide construction elements in the top bar and the outliner.

label: Provisions critical
summary: Whether the provisions are at a critical level.
details: Vanilla uses it to show a separate element when it is true, and the normal element when neither this nor IsProvisionsLow is true.

label: Provisions low
summary: Whether the provisions are running low.
details: Vanilla uses it to show a separate element when it is true, and the normal element when neither this nor IsProvisionsCritical is true.

label: Is valid
summary: Whether the domicile reference is valid.
details: Vanilla uses it to show the domicile window's content only when it is true. Going by its name, it guards against an empty reference.

label: Make scope
summary: Turns the domicile into a script scope so that script values can be run on it.
details: This is a promote, which means it changes the type of the thing the next part works on. Vanilla has no use on a domicile; the same-named function on others (for example on the player) is followed by ScriptValue('...').

label: The domicile itself
summary: The domicile itself, handed on as a value.
details: Vanilla passes it into other functions, for example to open the domicile view or to ask for the herd limit breakdown of this domicile.

label: Show building notification
summary: Whether the map icon should show a building notification.
details: Vanilla uses it to show or hide an element on the map icon layer.

label: Upgrade building
summary: A command that upgrades the given building in the domicile.
details: Vanilla runs it from the domicile window with the clicked building and the window, and enables the button only while the command is valid.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The building to upgrade.
fields.values: a domicile building, for example DomicileBuilding.Self

fields.name: Arg1
fields.text: The domicile window that issues the command.

label: Access itself
summary: Gives access to the building object itself, for the interface to hand on.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla uses the same name on a window widget (PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf) to pass the widget on, not on this type.

label: Asset
summary: The picture and sound set (asset) of the building for a given domicile.
details: Vanilla uses it in the domicile window as the data of a part of the window, with the window's domicile as the argument. It is a promote, so what follows works on the asset.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The domicile the asset is chosen for.

label: Build tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for building this building, for a given character.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the domicile window, passing Character.Self.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character the tooltip is for.

label: Building cost
summary: What the building costs for a given character.
details: Vanilla uses it in a tooltip text, where the result is passed to a cost-printing function ('Cost: ...'). Its return type is not registered, so the exact type is not known.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character the cost is for.

label: Building upgrades
summary: The upgrades that are possible for the building.
details: Going by its name only; vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Construction tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for the construction of this building, for a given character.
details: Vanilla uses it on the building under construction in the outliner and the title window, passing the player.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character the tooltip is for.

label: Demolish tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for demolishing the building.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the domicile window.

label: Description with line break
summary: The domicile building's description followed by a line break, as text.
details: Going by its name and its place in vanilla: building tooltips put it right before the "Effect:" heading, so the heading starts on a new line.

label: Description
summary: The description text of the building.
details: Going by its name and the same-named function on other types (a building, a government type, an activity type), which print a description. Vanilla has no use that names DomicileBuilding.GetDescription itself.

label: Inspect tree tooltip
summary: The tooltip text shown for the building in the inspected building tree.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the domicile window. Going by its name, it belongs to the line tree view of building upgrades.

label: Modifier description
summary: A text that lists what the building's modifiers do.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the domicile window and in the tooltip text of a single building, after the 'Effect:' heading.

label: Name
summary: The name of the building.
details: Vanilla uses it in effect texts such as 'Add [building] to [domicile]'.

label: Name and level
summary: The name of the building together with its level.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the domicile window and in the building tooltip.

label: Name, no tooltip
summary: The name of the building as plain text, without a hover tooltip.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the domicile window. Going by its name, it differs from GetName in having no tooltip attached.

label: Random asset
summary: A random picture and sound set (asset) of the building.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of a part of the domicile window and of the shared building tooltip. It is a promote, so what follows works on the asset.

label: Refund description
summary: A text that says what is refunded when the building is demolished.
details: Vanilla uses it in the demolish text 'you will be refunded: ...'.

label: Single building tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for the building on its own.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the shared cooltip (the game's tooltip layout).

label: Tier number
summary: The tier (level) number of the building.
details: Vanilla prints it in the text 'Upgrade to Level N'.

label: Upgrade tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for upgrading the building, for a given character.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the domicile window with the viewing character.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character the tooltip is for.

label: Has description
summary: Whether the building has a description.
details: Going by its name only; vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Has parameter
summary: Whether the building has the given parameter.
details: Vanilla asks it with 'can_receive_artifacts' in the domicile window to show or hide parts that depend on that.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The name of the building parameter.

label: Is internal
summary: Whether the building is an internal one, built in an internal slot.
details: Vanilla uses it in the domicile window to decide which parts to show. The slot types are named internal and external in the slot functions.

label: Is main building
summary: Whether the building is the main building of the domicile.
details: Vanilla uses it in the domicile window, for example to hide a part in edit mode when the building is not the main one.

label: Is root of track
summary: Whether the building is the first one of its upgrade line (track).
details: Going by its name and its use as a show/hide condition in the domicile window.

label: The building itself
summary: The building itself, handed on as a value.
details: Vanilla passes it into other functions, for example to build, demolish or upgrade it, or to inspect its line tree.

label: Access itself
summary: Gives access to the asset object itself, for the interface to hand on.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla uses the same name on a window widget (PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf), not on this type.

label: Icon
summary: The icon picture of the building asset.
details: Vanilla uses it as a texture in the domicile window.

label: Sound effect
summary: The sound effect of the building asset.
details: Going by its name only; vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Texture
summary: The main picture of the building asset.
details: Vanilla uses it as a texture in the domicile window.

label: Texture mask
summary: The mask picture of the building asset.
details: Vanilla uses it as the intersection mask texture of a picture in the domicile window.

label: The asset itself
summary: The building asset itself, handed on as a value.
details: Going by its name and the same-named function on other types. Vanilla has no use that names DomicileBuildingAsset.Self itself.

label: Access itself
summary: Gives access to the slot object itself, for the interface to hand on.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla uses the same name on a window widget (PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf), not on this type.

label: Can build
summary: Whether something can be built in the slot.
details: Vanilla uses it in the domicile window to show one part when it is true and another when it is not, and to make a free slot transparent when it is false.

label: Can scroll upgrades left
summary: Whether the list of internal upgrades can be scrolled to the left.
details: Vanilla uses it to show or hide a part of the domicile window; going by the name, the left scroll button.

label: Can scroll upgrades right
summary: Whether the list of internal upgrades can be scrolled to the right.
details: Vanilla uses it to show or hide a part of the domicile window; going by the name, the right scroll button.

label: Can upgrade external
summary: Whether the slot's external building can be upgraded.
details: Vanilla uses it in the domicile window to show or hide parts.

label: Can upgrade internal
summary: Whether the slot's internal buildings can be upgraded.
details: Going by its name only; vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Asset
summary: The asset (picture and sound set) of the slot.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of parts of the domicile window.

label: Building
summary: The building in the slot.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of parts of the domicile window.

label: Building type under construction
summary: The type of building that is being built in the slot.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of a part of the domicile window.

label: Construction days left
summary: A text with the days left until the slot's construction is finished.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the domicile window.

label: Internal slot tooltip
summary: The tooltip text for one internal slot.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the domicile window, with the internal slot of the entry as the argument.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The internal slot the tooltip is for.
fields.values: an internal slot, for example DomicileInternalGuiSlot.Self

label: Internal slots
summary: The list of internal slots of this slot.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list that the domicile window repeats over, one entry per internal slot.

label: Level
summary: The level of the slot, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla compares it with numbers in the domicile window, for example at most 2, or at least 3 but not 5, to pick what is shown.

label: Level text
summary: The level of the slot as text.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the domicile window.

label: Name
summary: The name of the slot.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the domicile window.

label: Position
summary: The position of the slot, as a pair of numbers (x and y).
details: Going by its name and its return type. Vanilla has no use that names DomicileBuildingSlot.GetPosition itself; the window uses GetPositionInPercent instead.

label: Position in percent
summary: The position of the slot as a share of its parent's size.
details: Vanilla sets the position of the slot's widget with it, passing the parent widget.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The parent widget the percentage refers to.

label: Potential internal upgrades
summary: The list of internal upgrades that could be built in the slot.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list that the domicile window repeats over.

label: Previous asset
summary: The asset (picture and sound set) the slot had before.
details: Going by its name and its use as the data of parts of the domicile window.

label: Size
summary: The size of the slot, as a pair of numbers (width and height).
details: Going by its name and its return type. Vanilla has no use that names DomicileBuildingSlot.GetSize itself; the window uses GetSizeInPercent instead.

label: Size in percent
summary: The size of the slot as a share of its parent's size.
details: Vanilla sets the size of the slot's widget with it, passing the parent widget.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The parent widget the percentage refers to.

label: Slot modifier description
summary: A text that lists what the slot's modifiers do.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the domicile window.

label: Has base building
summary: Whether the slot has a base building.
details: Vanilla uses it with other conditions to decide what the domicile window shows for a slot.

label: Has internal slots
summary: Whether the slot has internal slots.
details: Vanilla uses it with other conditions to decide whether the internal slot area is shown.

label: Has selected free internal slot
summary: Whether the selected internal slot is free.
details: Going by its name and its use in conditions of the domicile window.

label: Selected internal slot under construction
summary: Whether something is being built in the selected internal slot.
details: Vanilla uses it in conditions of the domicile window, often together with whether the selected slot is free.

label: Is dirty
summary: Whether the slot has changes that are not applied yet.
details: Going by its name ('dirty' usually means changed but not saved) and its use as a show/hide condition in the domicile window.

label: Is free
summary: Whether the slot is free, with no building in it.
details: Vanilla combines it with whether the slot is under construction and whether the window is in edit mode.

label: Is internal slot selected
summary: Whether the internal slot with the given index is selected.
details: Vanilla passes the index of the internal slot of the list entry.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The index of the internal slot.

label: Is internal slot under construction
summary: Whether something is being built in the internal slot with the given index.
details: Vanilla passes the index of the internal slot of the list entry, and combines it with whether that slot is free.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The index of the internal slot.

label: Is same slot type
summary: Whether the slot is of the same slot type as the given building.
details: Vanilla passes the building of the list entry and uses the result to show or hide it.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The building to compare with.
fields.values: a domicile building, for example DomicileBuilding.Self

label: Is under construction
summary: Whether something is being built in the slot.
details: Vanilla combines it with whether the slot is free and whether the window is in edit mode.

label: Is unlocked
summary: Whether the slot is unlocked.
details: Vanilla uses it to enable and show the slot, and to set the always-transparent flag on a part when it is locked.

label: Scroll upgrades left
summary: Scrolls the list of internal upgrades to the left.
details: Vanilla runs it when a button is clicked. It returns nothing.

label: Scroll upgrades right
summary: Scrolls the list of internal upgrades to the right.
details: Vanilla runs it when a button is clicked. It returns nothing.

label: Select internal slot
summary: Selects the internal slot with the given index.
details: Vanilla runs it when an internal slot is clicked, passing its index. It returns nothing.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The index of the internal slot to select.

label: The slot itself
summary: The building slot itself, handed on as a value.
details: Vanilla passes it into window functions, for example to select the slot, play its sound or clear its new-building effect.

label: Show internal scroll buttons
summary: Whether the scroll buttons for the internal upgrades should be shown.
details: Going by its name only; vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Access itself
summary: Gives access to the culture set object itself, for the interface to hand on.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla uses the same name on a window widget (PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf), not on this type.

label: Name
summary: The name of the culture set.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the domicile window.

label: The culture set itself
summary: The culture set itself, handed on as a value.
details: Going by its name and the same-named function on other types. Vanilla has no use that names DomicileCultureSet.Self itself.

label: Access itself
summary: Gives access to the follower card object itself, for the interface to hand on.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla uses the same name on a window widget (PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf), not on this type.

label: Amount text
summary: A text with the amount shown on the follower card.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the domicile window.

label: Animation
summary: The name of the animation the featured character plays on the card.
details: Vanilla passes it as the animation in the call that draws the animated portrait of a character in the council setting.

label: Featured character
summary: The character shown on the follower card.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of a part of the domicile window.

label: Followers
summary: The list of followers the card stands for.
details: Vanilla uses it as the list that the domicile window repeats over.

label: Icon frame
summary: The frame number of the card's icon, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla uses it as the frame of an icon in the domicile window.

label: Temperament description
summary: The tooltip text that describes the temperament of the card's followers.
details: Vanilla uses it as a tooltip in the domicile window.

label: Title
summary: The title text of the follower card.
details: Vanilla shows it as text in the domicile window.

label: Is empty
summary: Whether the follower card is empty.
details: Vanilla shows the card's content only when this is not true.

label: The card itself
summary: The follower card itself, handed on as a value.
details: Going by its name and the same-named function on other types. Vanilla has no use that names DomicileFollowerCardItem.Self itself.

label: Access itself
summary: Gives access to the internal slot object itself, for the interface to hand on.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla uses the same name on a window widget (PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf), not on this type.

label: Can upgrade
summary: Whether the building in the internal slot can be upgraded.
details: Vanilla uses it to show one part when true and another when not.

label: Building
summary: The building in the internal slot.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of parts of the domicile window.

label: Locked number
summary: A whole number for the locked state of the internal slot.
details: Going by its name only; vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Slot index
summary: The index of the internal slot, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla passes it to the slot functions that select an internal slot or ask whether it is selected or under construction.

label: Is free
summary: Whether the internal slot is free, with no building in it.
details: Vanilla combines it with whether construction is going on in the slot.

label: Is unlocked
summary: Whether the internal slot is unlocked.
details: Vanilla uses it to enable and show the slot, and to show a locked look when it is not.

label: The internal slot itself
summary: The internal slot itself, handed on as a value.
details: Vanilla passes it to the slot tooltip function.

label: Access itself
summary: Gives access to the line connection object itself, for the interface to hand on.
details: Going by its name only. Vanilla uses the same name on a window widget (PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf), not on this type.

label: Child
summary: The child end of the line connection, the item the line leads to.
details: Vanilla chains it with GetItem to get the data for a part of the domicile window. Going by its name, the line connects a parent to a child.

label: Line start
summary: The point where the line starts, as a pair of numbers (x and y).
details: Vanilla uses it as the 'from' point of a line drawn in the domicile window.

label: Line end
summary: The point where the line ends, as a pair of numbers (x and y).
details: Vanilla uses it as the 'to' point of a line drawn in the domicile window.

label: Parent
summary: The parent end of the line connection, the item the line comes from.
details: Going by its name and GetChild; vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: The connection itself
summary: The line connection itself, handed on as a value.
details: Going by its name and the same-named function on other types. Vanilla has no use that names DomicileLineConnection.Self itself.

label: Access item
summary: Gives access to the item of the line tree entry, for the interface to hand on.
details: Going by its name and the same-named function on a similar line item type (ObligationLevelLineItem), which is used as the data of a part of a window. Vanilla has no use that names DomicileLineItem.AccessItem itself.
